messages:
ana-c: Quick sync — we need a compact partner triage blueprint for the Q1 joint marketplace + SI launch. Goal: <2 minute handoff to partner oncall, clear fallback, and one-click war room creation.

michael-k: +1. Can we standardize channel naming and a short invocation flow? Current chaos when infra + SI both page.

lee-s: Suggest pattern: #partner-<partner>-sev-<region> (e.g., #partner-aurora-sev-us). Keeps routing predictable.

jess-r: Also need a pre-approved comms blurb for customer-facing messages. Legal wants a template.

ana-c: @jess-r (typo: ana-c) noted. We should build 3 artifacts: 1) channel naming + membership rules, 2) oncall rotation + escalation ladder, 3) war room runbook (invocation, roles, checklist).

michael-k: For invocation, propose a short slash flow and git ops link in channel topic. Example: `/call partner-warroom --partner=aurora --sev=2` -> creates bridge + ephemeral channel + pins runbook.

lee-s: We already have partner-oncall-bot; can it create the channel and invite the right roles? partner-oncall-bot: yes — bot can create, set topic, and post checklist if given flags. Need an allowlist for who can invoke.

jess-r: Who signs the allowlist? Sales or Partnerships? We need at least two approvers per partner (partnerships + support lead).

ana-c: Approvers: partnerships lead + support oncall manager. Action: @michael-k to add allowlist check to bot; @lee-s to draft rotation; @jess-r to prep comms template.

michael-k: Will add a validation step in the bot. Rough plan: if invoker not in allowlist -> bot responds with approval request workflow (DM to approvers). If approved within 10m -> create channel.

lee-s: Draft rotation idea: partner primary (SI oncall) -> partner secondary (Redwood dedicated oncall) -> platform SRE -> escalation to Eng triage. Each hop has a 15m ack window for Sev1.

jess-r: For marketplace partners that require NDA or special access, channel membership should be private and archived post-incident. We need a retention flag on creation.

michael-k: partner-oncall-bot: added support for `retention=short|long|ndaprotected`. Defaults to short for public launches.

partner-oncall-bot: War room created: #partner-aurora-sev-us-temp (invoked by ana-c). Pins: runbook, comms-template, bridge link.

ana-c: Nice — can we add a 1-paragraph checklist for the runbook? I can draft. Things to include: short context, customer impact, scoped mitigation, data sharing instructions, postmortem owner, next steps.

lee-s: Add a mandatory `no-shared-secrets` line — never paste keys. Instead use secure share link.

jess-r: Also include an internal summary template and customer-facing statement with placeholders for status + ETA.

michael-k: I'll link the `ops/runbooks/partner-triage.md` once we finalize. Also adding a small script to populate channel topic with oncall rotation + current pager.

ana-c: Timeline — aim to land an MVP blueprint and bot tweaks by next Wed (10am PT review). Anyone blocked?

lee-s: I can do rotation doc by Tue EOD.

jess-r: Comms template by Tue noon. Need Legal review — looping them in after initial draft.

michael-k: Bot changes will need a short test window; I'll have a PR up tomorrow.

ana-c: OK — I'll create a concise checklist PR and link drafts in the partner-runbook. After the internal review we'll schedule a 30m dry-run with the SI next Friday.

partner-oncall-bot: Reminder: dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-27T16:00:00Z (added by ana-c).

jess-r: Adding calendar invite now. :calendar:

michael-k: small note — ensure the bot logs to our audit bucket S3://redwood-partner-ops/logs for compliance.

lee-s: Acknowledged. Add retention policy and who can access logs.

ana-c: Great work team — will consolidate action items and post a one-pager in #partnerships. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
